title: Order
description: Customer order placed in an e-commerce system. Contains order details, customer information, item counts, pricing breakdown (subtotal, tax, shipping), payment method, delivery address, and order status.

order_number.description: Human-readable order number or reference code for customer tracking

customer_id.description: Foreign key reference to the customer who placed this order

customer_name.description: Full name of the customer who placed the order

customer_email.description: Email address of the customer for order confirmations and updates

items_count.description: Total number of distinct items/products in the order

subtotal.description: Sum of all item prices before taxes and shipping

tax.description: Total tax amount calculated based on applicable tax rates

shipping.description: Shipping and handling cost for the order

total.description: Final total amount including subtotal, tax, and shipping

currency.description: ISO currency code for all monetary values (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

status.description: Current order status (e.g., pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded)

payment_method.description: Payment method used (e.g., credit_card, paypal, bank_transfer, cash_on_delivery)

shipping_address.description: Complete delivery address where the order should be shipped

created_at.description: Timestamp when the order was placed

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the order was last modified
